status: Accepted on final frozen bytes; two measurement corrections resolved, no remaining production blocker found in this scope.
scope: Independent review of root endpoint and native media-chrome batches. No source edits, provider calls, device run or broad regression rerun.

sourceBinding.historicalMediaReceipt: Preserved unchanged; revised test hash and corrected pair numbers are bound by reviewed-acceptance.json.

independentExecution.counting: These29+7 are independent repeats of the owner cases, not36 additional unique regressions. The complete284-case admin result was not rerun here.

endpointConclusions: Malformed JSON now returns400 before Auth; byte cap, same-origin/object validation and enum-only user-bearer forwarding remain.
Original-audio range validation rejects reversed, empty, multipart and unsafe ranges before Storage; no untrusted URL or redirect is followed.
Network exceptions and the configured20-second header deadline return private unavailable responses with no raw error. That timer bounds headers, not the entire response stream or surrounding RPCs.
Both exact-object RPCs retain actor/session inputs. Existing SQL rechecks current staff/session and Storage object version; replaced or missing objects do not release stale bytes.

The fixture executes real route/Auth/session/permission/recovery code and installed SDK with request-local cookies and strict synthetic transport. Actual permission throws/redirects are not relabeled as framework HTTP acceptance.
nativeConclusions: FullscreenVideo changes media colors/backplates and their dimensions; playback, gesture, seek, mute, accessibility and timing handlers are unchanged.
TrendingStoriesRail adds a theme subscription and an independent dark footer; only this media context selects TierName inherited foreground. Default verification colors and shared tier lookup remain.

The existing player accessibility test change is only StyleSheet.create as an identity adapter; the original five behavioral assertions are unchanged. Their owner result is retained, not independently rerun here.
